name: Room 7
narrativeOnEnter: Tiny room. Bare mattress, barred window. The walls are covered in scratched numbers.

action.text:
PATIENT FILE — Patient 07
Name: VOSS, ELARA — Dr. E. Voss, Neuroscientist
Admission: March 14th, 1972 | Involuntary | Ward B — Room 7

Weekly 'EEG sessions' — 90 min. Patient restrained.
AXIOM notation: 'Neural mapping quality: EXCELLENT.'

Harlan's note: 'Gate code = admission date reversed: 4-0-3-1'

Later entry: 'She got out last night. I didn't tell anyone. — H'

Scratched into the plaster, over and over:

4031 4031 4031 4031 4031

'MY NAME IS ELARA VOSS'
'THERE ARE 47 OF US IN WARD B'
'IT IS NOT THERAPY. WE ARE DATA.'

At the bottom, different handwriting:
'She got out. I watched her go. — Agnes Colm, 1972'
Barred window — painted over. Scratch marks on one bar.

Under the mattress, a torn list: 47 names. Each stamped 'AXIOM — HELIOS Phase 1'.
Top entry underlined: 'VOSS, ELARA — Patient 07.'

Bottom of list: 'They mapped all of us. 90 minutes in a chair. — E. Voss'
